The assessment process

First, a closer look.
Then, a clear direction.

You do not need to decide between repair and replacement before asking for help.

Request an assessment
01

Start with what you know.

Describe the concern and any history you have: approximate age, previous repairs, recent weather, or changes inside the home. It is fine if some details are unknown. A plain description is a useful beginning.

02

Discuss how the roof will be assessed.

The real business should explain access, assessment arrangements, any charges, and what can be established. Some conditions may require further investigation rather than a conclusion from a single visible symptom.

03

Leave with questions answered.

A useful recommendation explains the findings, options, and proposed next step. Ask for clarity where a term or allowance is unfamiliar.

  • What condition was observed?
  • Which options are reasonable and why?
  • What does the proposed scope include?
  • What would need further investigation?
